digest.component_or_area: plan-review gate run summary & coverage reporting
propositions: Repeated LLM step failures that do not abort the run are invisible to gate run callers because they are swallowed at ~13 call sites and never recorded in the plan-review verdict JSON.
An overlap-judge batch call that fails produces an empty overlap[] that is byte-identical to one produced by a genuine non-overlap, making silent degradation indistinguishable from correct behavior.
All failed LLM calls funnel through a single seam (runner.py except block) that logs to JSONL spend rows but never surfaces in-memory to the verdict.
Plan-review verdict coverage.chunk_errors is write-only with no reader and covers only Pass-1 chunks, leaving no general counter for survived LLM step failures.

A run-scoped contextvar sink must record survived LLM failures at the runner seam and drain into coverage.llm_step_failures shaped {total, by_step} only when non-empty, so clean runs remain byte-identical for attestation safety.
The failure counter must use _call_label verbatim as keys so operators can match by_step counts to log lines grepped from runner output.
